player_prompt.intro:
We uyu Mchezaji {player_id} ({role}) katika mchezo wa {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies.
- Kila raundi, tuma [heads] au [tails] (au [h], [t]).
- Ikiwa chaguo lako linapatana na la mpinzani wako, Mchezaji 0 anashinda raundi; vinginevyo Mchezaji 1 anashinda.
Jibu na chaguo lako kwa fomu '[heads]' au '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mchezaji 0 anachagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 anachagua {choice1}. Match -> Mchezaji 0 anashinda
message.round_mismatch: Mchezaji 0 anachagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 anachagua {choice1}. Mismatch -> Mchezaji 1 anashinda.

outcome.p0_wins: Munthu uyo wali na nambala 0 ndiyo wakathereska.
outcome.p1_wins: Munthu wakwamba ndiyo wakawina viphalizgano vinandi.
